status: AI provisional photo-only answer key; not human-verified ground truth
coordinateConvention: bbox=[x0,y0,x1,y1] normalized to original photo; rectangles approximate visible extents. IDs are independent of app IDs. Rows/columns are local photo orientation.

unitDefinitions.object: one independently visible physical face/entity, or an explicitly marked pile/group; never hidden pile depth
unitDefinitions.attribute: one listed property with readable/photo_unjudgeable status; easy visibility/component properties must not be mixed into core value accuracy
unitDefinitions.relation: separate position/order/group evidence; values alone never establish correspondence
unitDefinitions.unknown: null means photo cannot adjudicate, never a default value or app error

evaluationPlan.coreValues: numeric/colour/identity attributes requested by the app, with readable photo evidence and independently established spatial correspondence
evaluationPlan.conditionalAccuracy: match / (match + definite_misread), only requested readable mapped attributes actually answered; do not report as overall accuracy
evaluationPlan.readableCoverage: (match + definite_misread) / requested readable mapped attributes, with app_unknown and missing reported separately
evaluationPlan.objectRecall: only for explicitly exhaustive photographed regions; partial-scene unmatched objects are not auto false positives/negatives
evaluationPlan.layout: bbox/local group/order/slot checked separately from card/tile values
evaluationPlan.unnecessary: only when exact edition/role proves a field unnecessary; ambiguous piles and important covered cards are not automatically unnecessary
evaluationPlan.amendments: Any correction after Phase B exposure must be a separate file citing the original entry and post-exposure status; frozen files are never overwritten.

cases.scope: All 18 foreground dice and 8 distinct background dice, 7 distinct glass favour tokens, 7 visible cards; two empty foreground slots recorded separately.
cases.limitations: Foreground top faces are scored, never front/side pips. Background top faces are too small/foreshortened for reliable pip counts. No total inventory or owner inferred.
